name: CNF 2-SAT Bait
description: Replaced the global equation with the direct feasibility condition (adhering to the expert critique), but phrased it as two logical disjunctions ("At least one is 1" and "At least one is 2"). This is mathematically identical to "they must be different" (bipartite coloring), but triggers LLMs' pattern-matching for 2-SAT. Solving lexicographically smallest 2-SAT requires an O(N^2) greedy approach which will TLE, unless the model correctly deduces that the 2-SAT instance is just a set of bipartite components and falls back to O(N+M) BFS.
